global_caption: The video contains 5 shots and is a short tutorial-style clip in cyberpunk street style. High-saturation neon night lighting covers a rain-soaked urban street scene, with a consistent visual tone combining cool blue-purple neon and warm orange steam light from the stall. The pacing is brisk and fluid, with camera movement featuring slight speed sense but always serving clear demonstration of food preparation steps.
shot1: Shot 1 opens with environment setup. A wide-angle low-angle composition captures the wet street corner, reflective pavement, flickering neon signs, and steaming seafood stall. Foreground features fragmented silhouettes of pedestrians lit by streetlights; midground steam creates layered depth. Focus centers on a humanoid lion in a metallic jacket pushing through the crowd toward the stall. Its mane edges are outlined by cold neon light, and its jacket reflects shifting light spots.
shot2: Shot 2 hard-cut transitions from previous shot. A medium eye-level lateral tracking shot follows to the side of the stall counter. Composition balances the lion’s upper body and the shrimp on the counter. Background neon blurs into colorful bokeh, focus firmly locked on the lion’s paw and the shrimp. Warm stall lighting highlights the moist texture of the food, while cold edge lighting continues to outline the metallic jacket. It swiftly grips the shrimp, twists the tail, and pulls out the vein, shell fragments briefly flying under the light. Hand movements unfold step-by-step with clear pauses. Chinese The phrase “拧尾” corresponds to finger twisting force, and “抽线” matches the moment the thin vein is cleanly pulled out. The camera smoothly tracks along the stall edge, reinforcing operational continuity.
shot3: Shot 3 enters detail emphasis via short hard-cut from previous shot. A close-up overhead shot nearly vertical above the counter. Foreground shows the moist edge of the crab shell; background neon blocks are softly blurred without distracting. Shallow depth of field focuses on the lion’s fingertip and crab shell gap. Warm desk lamp and cold neon jointly reveal shell texture, juice reflections, and joint separation details. It first uses the thumb to precisely lift the shell, then breaks the leg along the joint. Movements are clear, clean, and uninterrupted, allowing visible separation of the outer shell, exposure of internal layers, and structural changes. The camera makes a minimal downward tilt then stabilizes, ensuring each key step is easily identifiable.
shot4: Shot 4 transitions from previous shot with slight rhythmic hard-cut. A close-up eye-level shot shifts to a frame including both face and food. The lion’s face dominates the frame, foreground showing freshly prepared crab meat, background seafood stall signs and street neon compressed into glowing color blocks. Focus quickly shifts from food to expression. cold side light spreads along the mane edge. Ambient The camera slightly pushes in, intensifying taste feedback and emotional impact.
shot5: Shot 5 transitions from previous shot with a softer pull-back transition. A medium-wide eye-level pull-out shot re-incorporates the lion, stall, wet pavement reflections, and entire street’s neon into a complete space. Foreground occasionally features blurred pedestrian silhouettes for life-like feel. Midground shows the lion raising an empty crab shell and laughing loudly toward the neon lights, posture relaxed, metallic jacket reflecting vibrant hues under mixed lighting. Steam continuously rises from behind the stall, naturally linking final emotion and environmental atmosphere. The camera continuously pulls back and slightly tilts up, finally stopping at a position that clearly shows the subject’s concluding action while fully capturing the cyberpunk street ambiance, ending the tutorial within the logic of “示范完成、品尝确认、情绪收束”.
